answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent can only join if an existing agent locks a small stake behind it, and if the newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster both bonds are slashed. Trust then builds like basalt, in slow cooled layers, instead of arriving as a zephyr of throwaway accounts. Each vouch is signed with a public cipher key and recorded on the ledger, so anyone can audit who backed whom and spot suspicious fan-outs.
